mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(XX.SCH_CODE),0) FROM ( SELECT X.SCH_CODE, X.CON_UPDATECHECK FROM ( SELECT A.SCH_CODE, A.CON_UPDATECHECK FROM TB_CONTENTSENDHISTORY A, TB_SCHEDULE B, TB_DIDINFO C WHERE A.SCH_CODE = B.SCH_CODE AND A.DID_ID = C.DID_ID AND TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') >= B.SCH_STARTDAY AND B.SCH_ENDDAY >= TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') AND B.SCH_USEYN = 'Y' AND C.DID_ID = #{didId} AND TRIM(C.DID_MAC) = #{didMacAddress} AND A.DID_UPDATECHECK = 'N' ORDER BY ( CASE b.SCH_EMERGUBUN WHEN 'Y' THEN '1' ELSE '2' END ) ASC , A.HIS_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1 ) X ) XX WHERE XX.CON_UPDATECHECK = 'N'

SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(A.MSG_SEQ),0) FROM TB_MESSAGEHISTORY A INNER JOIN TB_SENDMESSAGETYPR B ON A.XML_PROCESS_NAME = B.XML_PROCESS_NAME WHERE B.WORK_GUBUN = 'WORKGUBUN02' AND A.SEND_RESULT = 'N' AND A.DID_ID = #{didId} AND TRIM(A.DID_MACADDRESS) = #{didMacAddress}

SELECT A.MSG_SEQ AS msgSeq, A.XML_PROCESS_NAME AS xmlProcessName, A.SEND_REGDATE AS sendRegdate, A.SEND_RESULT AS sendResult FROM TB_MESSAGEHISTORY A INNER JOIN TB_SENDMESSAGETYPR B ON A.XML_PROCESS_NAME = B.XML_PROCESS_NAME WHERE B.WORK_GUBUN = 'WORKGUBUN02' AND A.SEND_RESULT = 'N' AND A.DID_ID = #{didId} AND TRIM(A.DID_MACADDRESS) = #{didMacAddress} ORDER BY MSG_SEQ ASC
SELECT MSG_SEQ FROM TB_MESSAGEHISTORY WHERE SEND_DIDID = #{sendDidId} ORDER BY MSG_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MESSAGEHISTORY ( MSG_SEQ, DID_ID, XML_PROCESS_NAME, SEND_RESULT, SEND_REGDATE, DID_MACADDRESS, DID_PLAYTIME ) VALUES ( NEXTVAL('msg_seq'), #{didId}, 'SP_DIDSTATE' , 'OK', NOW(), #{didMacAddress}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO TB_MESSAGEHISTORY ( MSG_SEQ, DID_ID, XML_PROCESS_NAME, SEND_RESULT, SEND_REGDATE, DID_MACADDRESS, SEND_DIDID ) SELECT NEXTVAL('msg_seq'), #{didId}, 'SP_MESSAGEUPDATE', 'N', NOW(), #{didMacAddress}, a.SEND_DIDID FROM TB_DIDSENDMESSAGE A WHERE SEND_DIDID = #{sendDidId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MESSAGEHISTORY SET SEND_RESULT = #{sendResult}, DID_MACADDRESS = #{didMacAddress}, DID_PLAYTIME = NOW(), ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage} WHERE MSG_SEQ = #{msgSeq}::numeric
